column1: # Known losses of the round trip (design section 12.2). Columns, separated by tabs: language,
# settings, input, typeset, to_plain and code. Invisible characters are written with the markers of
# `vis`: the no-break space as U+237D and the narrow no-break space as U+23B5. `default` is
# RuleSet::PROSE with the settings of the language; a named setting changes only that one.
# The typeset column is the exact output of the set, glue included.
